posts.title: Megalopolis
posts.description: I’ve been in Bangkok the last two weeks, and three times in the last six months. The city is incredible. It’s well over 10 million people, approaching that of Istanbul, which is the largest city in all of Europe. posts.title: Build / Buy / Bot
posts.description: In the old days when you ran your startup, you had to focus on your core objectives very closely in the early days. You had a limited number of innovation tokens, and beyond that you had to focus on your core product exclusively. No sysadminning (Heroku/Lambda), no hard drives (S3), no databases (RDS), no CDN (Cloudflare), no geth (Infura).

posts.title: Show Candidates Your Cap Table.
posts.description: It’s hard enough trying to decide if you should take a job with an early-stage startup. There’s so much uncertainty: the product, your reputation, salary (as always), and, of course, equity.
